CHARGING
========

CHARGING VIA AC WALL OUTLET
---------------------------

To charge the battery pack from an AC wall outlet, connect it to |BP_HOST_PRODUCT_NAME|.

.. list-table::
   :header-rows: 0
   :widths: 12 88

   * - **WARNING**
     - Ensure all products are powered off before connecting the |BP_HOST_PRODUCT_SHORT_NAME| to the Jackery Battery Pack 2000.

.. image:: asset:charging/jbp2000b/ac_wall
   :alt: AC wall charging connection through |BP_HOST_PRODUCT_NAME|.
   :width: 100%

CHARGING VIA SOLAR PANELS (SOLD SEPARATELY)
-------------------------------------------

Charge the battery pack using solar panels and |BP_HOST_PRODUCT_NAME|, as shown in the figure below. For more information, refer to the user manual for |BP_HOST_PRODUCT_NAME|.

.. image:: asset:charging/jbp2000b/solar
   :alt: Solar charging connection through |BP_HOST_PRODUCT_NAME|.
   :width: 500px
